items.title: Frankfurter Buchmesse 2026: Programs Explore AI's Impact on Translation, and the Future of Publishing
items.excerpt: Research presented in Czechia's Frankfurt pavilion examined how publishing professionals use AI — and why literary translators remain concerned about its effects on their livelihoods.

items.title: “이 소설, 당신이 썼나요” AI 시대 맞은 문학상, ‘작가 검증’ 나섰다
items.excerpt: 국내 한 장편소설 공모전 최종심 작품이 작가의 실제 집필 과정 검증에서 의문이 제기돼 수상 기회를 잃는 등, 문학상들이 AI 시대를 맞아 심사에 '작가 검증' 절차를 도입하고 있다.

items.title: Guest Post – Artificial Intelligence in Scholarly Publishing: Are We Moving Faster Than the Evidence?
items.excerpt: A guest blogger argues the next phase of AI adoption in scholarly publishing — from manuscript screening to peer review tools — needs more evaluation, collaboration and human judgment.

items.title: Japan Actors Union Develops Guidelines for Generative AI Use
items.excerpt: Japan's actors union, including Dragon Ball voice cast members, unveiled guidelines for generative AI use covering voice cloning and synthetic performances.

items.title: Why Are Publishers Suing Big Tech With One Hand and Embracing AI With the Other?
items.excerpt: Written after an Authors Guild panel on authorship and AI, the essay examines publishers that litigate against AI companies while quietly adopting AI tools in their own production workflows.

items.title: Thélyson Orélien denies using AI to write novel but admits to plagiarism in earlier work
items.excerpt: Canadian author Thélyson Orélien has denied using AI to write his prize-winning novel C'était ça ou mourir, while admitting 'unacceptable' plagiarism in earlier work.

items.title: SoA's position on generative AI 'remains unchanged' after backlash to Ethical AI Charter
items.excerpt: Society of Authors CEO Anna Ganley responded to criticism of its Charter of Ethical AI Use in the Creative Industries, saying the body's stance on generative AI has not changed.

items.title: AI Copyright Bills Stall as Google Buys Up Korean Books
items.excerpt: Google is negotiating to buy Korean books for AI training, while bills strengthening copyright protection for AI training data remain stalled in the National Assembly.

items.title: Frankfurt Book Fair 2026: Three Views of Innovation
items.excerpt: The CEOs of Sourcebooks, Abrams and Perfect Bound describe adopting AI across accounting, marketing and production workflows — and urge publishers to build their own AI-produced models.

items.title: How to Listen to Kindle Books With CastReader
items.excerpt: A guide to CastReader, which reads Kindle Cloud Reader books aloud with cloud AI voices and offers an 'AI Explain' reading-assistant feature for unfamiliar passages.

items.title: 플리토, 교보문고 광화문·강남·동대문점에 AI 통번역 ‘보글’ 적용…외국인 고객 응대 실증
items.excerpt: 플리토가 교보문고 3개 매장에 도서 분류명·작가명을 사전 학습한 AI 통번역 '보글'을 공급해 외국인 고객 응대 실증을 진행했다. 정식 도입을 추진 중이다.

items.title: Can Naav AI Break English's Hold on Indian Literature? Vikram Sampath Thinks So
items.excerpt: Naav AI translates books across Indian and foreign languages with AI, then has human experts refine the output to preserve the author's voice and cultural context.

items.title: Turn your PDFs into audiobooks with ChatGPT — here's the simple trick
items.excerpt: A new tool connects ChatGPT with AI-generated narration to turn documents and books into listenable audio.

items.title: Kids' Content Is Deeply Broken. A New Platform Wants to Fix It
items.excerpt: Low-quality AI-generated content dominates children's media; Maka, a platform run by child-development experts, positions itself as a curated alternative to AI slop.
